subtitle: Three guide chapters that pass and still draw every report
description: A fixture for check-book.sh's reports: the lines a human should read that fail nothing. It exits 0, and every report the checker has fires at least once.

Chapter 1 has a sentence over 45 words, a callout doing two jobs in six sentences, and a header naming a repo-path source key that has no display name. Chapter 2's summary runs past 120 words and copies a run from its own body. All three chapters share one stock phrase.
